name: hcportal_getRunEmailContext
description: The portal's door to run emails (E9.F6.S6-S9, portal parity with the app, 2026-10-09). Authenticates the portal device (HC6.ValidatePortalAuth), resolves the run by PublicEventId (not deleted, not removed), checks the caller may create/edit runs for the kennel via HC6.CheckKennelPermission('createEditRuns') — a hare of this run passes through the hare exemption — then decides whether the caller may see addresses (the same permission WITHOUT the hare exemption) and hands over to HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext, the one place the send list is built. Called by the RunEmail API endpoint with client = 'portal'. Portal twin of HC6.hcapp_getRunEmailContext.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: portal device id, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived portal token, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: The run, by its public id. Required: NULL returns 'publicEventId is required'.

parameters.name: includeRecipients
parameters.description: 0 (default) = context only (rowsets 0-1); 1 = also the send list (rowset 2); 2 = also the kennel members who will NOT get it, with the reason (rowset 3 — the audience page).

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } on auth failure, NULL @publicEventId, 'That run no longer exists.' (no live run with that PublicEventId), or 'You cannot send emails for this run.' (CheckKennelPermission refused; logged to HC.ErrorLog with kennel and event ids). No other rowsets follow. A runtime error inside the TRY (from the second permission check or nonApi_runEmailContext) is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown — no envelope.

rowsets.name: RunContext
rowsets.description: Exactly one row: the run, its kennel and the sender (HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext rowset 0).

columns.name: publicEventId
columns.description: HC.Event.PublicEventId, lower-cased text — for the run's web link.

columns.name: senderEmail
columns.description: The caller's HC.Hasher.Email (may be generated — HC6.IsGeneratedEmail).

columns.name: instruction
columns.description: HC.Kennel.RunEmailInstruction — the kennel's saved drafting instruction for the assistant.

rowsets.name: History
rowsets.description: Exactly one row: what has been sent for this run, how many would get the next one, and whether the caller may see addresses (nonApi_runEmailContext rowset 1).

columns.name: emailSendCount
columns.description: HC.Event.EmailSendCount — emails sent for this run so far.

columns.name: emailLastSentCount
columns.description: HC.Event.EmailLastSentCount — recipients of the last send.

columns.name: recipientCount
columns.description: How many hashers the send list holds now.

columns.name: callerMaySeeEmails
columns.description: 1 when the caller holds createEditRuns on the kennel WITHOUT the hare exemption — the recipient rowsets then carry addresses; 0 for a hare who may edit only this run.

rowsets.name: Recipients
rowsets.description: Only when @includeRecipients >= 1: the send list (reasonCode 1 on for this run, 2 on for the kennel, 9 member, 10 follower, 11 RSVP Yes/Maybe), ORDER BY LOWER(hashName).

columns.name: email
columns.description: The hasher's HC.Hasher.Email. The SP returns it UNMASKED for every caller; the RunEmail API endpoint (api/Endpoints/RunEmail.cs) drops it unless callerMaySeeEmails = 1.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: The kennel hash name, else the hasher's DisplayName (same value as hashName; kept for older clients).

columns.name: canMove
columns.description: 1 when an admin may leave them out for one send.

rowsets.name: NonRecipients
rowsets.description: Only when @includeRecipients = 2: the kennel's members who will NOT get it and why, same columns as Recipients, ORDER BY LOWER(hashName). reasonCode: 3 run emails off, 4 kennel emails off, 5 not a member, follower or RSVP, 6 no email address, 7 blocked all emails, 8 email bouncing.

columns.name: email
columns.description: The hasher's HC.Hasher.Email. The SP returns it UNMASKED for every caller; the RunEmail API endpoint (api/Endpoints/RunEmail.cs) drops it unless callerMaySeeEmails = 1.

columns.name: canMove
columns.description: 1 when an admin may add them for one send; 0 for 6, 7, 8.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.CheckKennelPermission twice ('createEditRuns' with @isHareOfEvent for the gate, lines 59-60; without the hare exemption for @seeEmails, lines 73-74)
EXEC HC6.nonApi_runEmailContext (@eventId, @userId, @includeRecipients, @callerMaySeeEmails) — produces every success rowset, line 75
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on a refused permission check (lines 63-64, HcVersion '<portal>') and from the CATCH block (lines 79-80, after the ROLLBACK guard), then THROW

codeSmells.issue: Address masking lives in the API, not the SP
codeSmells.detail: The SP computes @seeEmails (lines 72-74) and nonApi_runEmailContext returns it as callerMaySeeEmails, but the email column in rowsets 2-3 is returned unmasked for every caller; only api/Endpoints/RunEmail.cs (ToJson(ctx.CallerMaySeeEmails)) withholds it from a hare who may edit only this run. Any other caller of this SP would expose the addresses.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
